decision: Hotend, relay test at 210 degC: real machines cycle in 24 to 55 s (median 37), Ku 0.102 to 0.199 (median 0.158). The old model: 25.8 s (at the low edge). The fitted Ender hotend: 5.4 s (it really is that light: the log shows it cooling 2.6 K/s at 245 degC), outside. The v6 class (fitted structure, Prusa's E3D V6 totals) with Prusa's own lag of 2.1 s: 12.6 s, outside. Its sensor lag was therefore raised to 8 s (inside the 2.9 to 10 s that Marlin's MPC sets imply): 24.9 s and Ku 0.164 with a 40 W heater, inside the band but below the median; with the 30 W cartridge of printer_v4 / v5, 22.8 s and Ku 0.208, just under the 10th percentile. The model still cycles faster than a typical real hotend.

The v6 class (fitted structure, Prusa's E3D V6 totals) with Prusa's own lag of 2.1 s: 12.6 s, outside. Its sensor lag was therefore raised to 8 s (inside the 2.9 to 10 s that Marlin's MPC sets imply): 24.9 s and Ku 0.164 with a 40 W heater, inside the band but below the median; with the 30 W cartridge of printer_v4 / v5, 22.8 s and Ku 0.208, just under the 10th percentile. Beds of printer_v4 / v5: printer_v4 Tu 48.6 s, Ku 0.415, printer_v5 Tu 48.3 s, Ku 0.415 against 22.831 to 160.673 s and 0.351 to 1.075: inside, nothing changed.
